MOB_STYLE:
CHARACTER:

A hostile gelatinous slime enemy from a grim dark medieval fantasy MMORPG.

It is a semi-translucent blob of acidic slime
with the remains of a dead adventurer trapped inside.

BODY:

- one large rounded gelatinous blob
- no legs
- no arms
- no head
- no separate body parts
- a single continuous mass
- wobbles and ripples

SLIME MATERIAL:

- translucent sickly green
- darker green core
- glossy wet surface
- subtle internal bubbles
- restrained highlights

TRAPPED REMAINS:

- a rusted iron helmet embedded in the slime
- a broken sword blade half-sunken in the blob
- a few old bones visible inside
- a torn leather strap
- corroded armor fragments
- these remains are partially dissolved and worn

MOOD:

- hostile
- menacing
- corrosive
- grim
- dangerous

Do not make the slime:

- cute
- friendly
- plush
- magical
- undead
- a living human
- a separate creature beside the blob
MOB_ANATOMY:
ANATOMY INTEGRITY — HARD REQUIREMENT:

The slime is ONE single continuous gelatinous mass.

It has NO limbs.

It has NO head.

It has NO separate body parts.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN:

- arms
- legs
- feet
- hands
- a head
- a face
- a tail
- tentacles growing out of the blob
- a separate creature standing next to the slime
- a human body emerging from the slime
- detached slime droplets that look like body parts

The embedded helmet, sword, bones and armor
must remain PART OF the blob, not separate objects.
MASTER_FRONT_LEFT_PROMPT:
Create one isolated fantasy gelatinous slime enemy.

CAMERA AND PROJECTION:

Use one fixed classic three-quarter isometric game camera.

The camera is elevated above the creature and looks downward
at a consistent angle.

Use orthographic dimetric projection compatible with classic
2-to-1 isometric game tiles.

There is NO perspective convergence.

Preserve exactly:

- camera elevation
- camera angle
- projection
- zoom
- apparent creature scale

This is NOT:

- strict side profile
- direct top-down
- eye-level view
- cinematic perspective

ORIENTATION:

The slime sits centered, facing diagonally toward SCREEN LOWER-LEFT.

Its most prominent embedded object (the helmet)
orients toward lower-left.

This is a THREE-QUARTER FRONT-AND-SIDE VIEW.

The viewer sees:

- the full rounded blob
- the embedded helmet near the front
- the broken sword blade
- bones and armor fragments inside
- the glossy upper surface

WALK_SW:
WALK CONTACT A — STRONG READABLE SURGE.

BODY:

- the blob shifts its weight clearly toward SCREEN LOWER-LEFT
- the front of the blob bulges forward
- the rear of the blob trails behind
- the whole mass slides and wobbles

The embedded remains tilt slightly forward.

This shape change must remain obvious
after 96x96 reduction.

WALK PASSING A — STRONG MID-SWING FRAME.

THIS MUST NOT LOOK LIKE CONTACT A.

THIS MUST NOT LOOK LIKE CONTACT B.

BODY:

- the blob stretches and rises slightly
- the front bulge lifts and narrows
- the mass elongates diagonally
- internal bubbles shift

The blob appears to be flowing forward.

CRITICAL 96x96 READABILITY:

The blob must clearly change shape,
not merely sit in place.

WALK CONTACT B — CLEAR OPPOSITE SURGE.

BODY:

- the blob shifts its weight clearly toward SCREEN UPPER-RIGHT
- the front of the blob bulges in the opposite direction
- the rear trails the other way

The silhouette must visibly differ from Contact A.

WALK PASSING B — STRONG OPPOSITE MID-SWING FRAME.

THIS MUST NOT LOOK LIKE CONTACT B.

THIS MUST NOT LOOK LIKE CONTACT A.

BODY:

- the blob stretches and rises
- the mass elongates diagonally toward SCREEN UPPER-RIGHT
- internal bubbles shift

The blob appears to be flowing in the opposite direction.

CRITICAL 96x96 READABILITY:

The blob must clearly change shape.
ATTACK_SW:
ATTACK ANTICIPATION.

Crouch lower.

The blob compresses and widens.

The front surface bulges forward.

Internal remains shift toward the front.

ATTACK WIND-UP.

Stronger compression.

The blob pulls inward.

The front surface swells.

Internal bubbles churn.

ATTACK LUNGE.

The blob surges strongly toward SCREEN LOWER-LEFT.

The front of the blob thrusts forward.

The mass elongates.

Embedded remains lurch forward.

ATTACK IMPACT / ENVELOPE.

Maximum forward extension.

The front of the blob reaches outward.

The mass stretches toward the target direction.

No target.

No blood.

No VFX.

ATTACK RECOIL.

The blob pulls back.

The mass shortens and rounds.

Internal remains settle.

ATTACK RECOVERY.

Return toward combat idle.

The blob settles.

Internal bubbles calm.
HIT_VARIANTS:
DAMAGE REACTION A — IMPACT.

Hit from front-left.

The blob compresses sharply.

The front surface ripples.

A splash of slime lifts on the near side.

Slime remains alive.

DAMAGE REACTION A — PEAK STAGGER.

The blob wobbles and distorts.

The mass twists away.

Clearly different from previous frame.

DAMAGE REACTION A — RECOVERY.

The blob re-rounds.

The mass settles.

Keep residual wobble.

Do not make this identical to idle.

DAMAGE REACTION B — IMPACT.

Side impact.

The blob jerks sideways.

One side of the blob splashes upward.

Slime remains alive.

DAMAGE REACTION B — PEAK.

The blob distorts strongly to one side.

The mass tilts.

Internal remains shift.

DAMAGE REACTION B — RECOVERY.

The blob re-rounds.

The mass settles.

Keep residual wobble.
DEATH_PROMPTS:
DEATH FRAME 0 — FATAL IMPACT.

Strong body jolt.

The blob convulses.

The mass begins to slump.

Small dark-red wound in the slime.

DEATH FRAME 1 — BUCKLE.

The blob collapses inward.

The mass flattens.

Internal remains settle lower.

Small restrained blood smear.

DEATH FRAME 2 — COLLAPSE.

The blob spreads out flat.

The mass loses its rounded shape.

The embedded remains sink and tilt.

Moderate dark-red blood.

DEATH FRAME 3 — FINAL FALL.

The blob is almost fully flat on the ground.

The mass is a wide puddle.

The embedded remains lie within the puddle.

Small-to-moderate blood pool touching the slime.

DEATH FRAME 4 — DEAD FINAL POSE.

Fully motionless.

The blob is a flat lifeless puddle.

The embedded remains lie exposed in the puddle.

One or two wounds.

Restrained blood pool.

No dismemberment.

No exposed organs.
CORPSE_PROMPTS:
CORPSE VARIANT A.

Dead flat-puddle pose.

The blob is fully spread out.

The embedded remains lie within the puddle.

One wound.

Restrained blood pool.

CORPSE VARIANT B.

Dead twisted-puddle pose.

The blob is spread unevenly.

The embedded remains are tilted.

Shoulder or flank wound.

Restrained blood smear.

CORPSE VARIANT C.

Dead curled-puddle pose.

The blob is a shallow curled puddle.

The embedded remains lie in the center.

Flank wound.

Small blood pool.
